name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.166: The two candidate settings now agree with each other, and the search obeys them.
    "Max candidates per language" used to be ignored by the search, which stopped at a hard-coded
    three per language no matter what the setting said, and a budget below "keep X" made that
    setting unreachable. Both numbers are derived from one place now.
